import sys

from slugkit.core import slugify
# Test regression cases
print('Testing regression:')
print(slugify('Hello--World'))  # expected hello-world
print(slugify('a -- b'))        # expected a-b
print(slugify('end!'))          # expected end
# Additional acceptance criteria
print(slugify('one , two ; three'))  # one-two-three
print(slugify('x___y'))              # x-y
print(slugify('end!'))               # end
print(slugify('  padded  '))         # padded
print(slugify('--both--'))           # both
print(slugify('(parens)'))           # parens
print(repr(slugify('')))             # ''
print(repr(slugify('!!!')))          # ''
print(repr(slugify('   ')))          # ''
print(slugify('Hello World'))        # hello-world
print(slugify('already-a-slug'))     # already-a-slug
print(slugify('Python 3'))           # python-3
print(slugify('MiXeD CaSe 42'))      # mixed-case-42
print(slugify('café crème'))         # caf-cr-me
print(repr(slugify('日語')))          # ''
# TypeError checks
for inp in [None, 3, 2.5, ['a'], b'bytes']:
    try:
        slugify(inp)
        print(f'ERROR: {inp} did not raise TypeError')
    except TypeError:
        pass
